page0.text:
My body melts.
My MIND dissolves.
My soul comes apart.

page1.text:
"Ah......"
Dark fingers encircle me.
Tendrils seize me with bottomless greed, leaving no opening to escape.
"ah..."
My body sinks into the black mud.
I sink endlessly. The ocean surface grows distant.
The grip gently tightens, capturing me in a total embrace.

page2.text:
...
My limbs are gone.
I become part of the inky blackness, falling to my final resting place in the deep.
